notes: Classic Era community-standard builds. Druids raid as Restoration healers (Swiftmend build early, Nature's Grace/Improved Regrowth build late), Feral is a strong off-tank/dungeon tank and a powershifting cat, Balance is a one-per-raid Moonkin. Allocations validated against the Classic tree data.

builds.name: Restoration — Swiftmend Healer (5/0/46)
builds.summary: The full Restoration tree: Swiftmend burst, Gift of Nature (+10% healing), Improved Regrowth (+50% Regrowth crit), Nature's Swiftness, Improved Rejuvenation/Healing Touch, Tranquil Spirit and Reflection, with Subtlety for threat. Five leftover points go to Improved Wrath for questing. The first build to run at 60.

core.why: Consume a Rejuvenation/Regrowth for an instant heal — tank-saving burst.
+35% Mark/Gift of the Wild for the raid.
Prerequisite for Gift of Nature; a fine DoT while soloing.

flex.why: Icy Veins suggests Improved Wrath for questing; Nature's Grasp is the PvP/dungeon utility choice.

notes: Rejuvenation + Regrowth on the tank, Swiftmend for emergencies, Healing Touch with Nature's Swiftness; Innervate the priest.
As gear improves, move to the Nature's Grace / Improved Regrowth build below.

builds.name: Restoration — Regrowth / Nature's Grace (21/0/30)
builds.summary: The endgame Regrowth build: Nature's Grace (-0.5s cast after a crit) chained with Improved Regrowth's +50% crit means near-permanent fast Regrowths, with Gift of Nature and Reflection behind it. Gives up Swiftmend, Nature's Swiftness, Tranquil Spirit and Improved Rejuvenation for 20 points of Balance utility.

core.why: Every crit makes the next spell 0.5s faster — with Improved Regrowth it is up constantly.
Healing Touch cast time for the big heals.
-30% shapeshift cost — bear/travel emergencies cost less.
+20% range on Balance spells (Roots, Moonfire, Hibernate).

flex.default: Balance utility (Improved Wrath, Nature's Grasp, Improved Entangling Roots, Natural Shapeshifter, Improved Thorns, Nature's Reach)
alternatives: Natural Weapons + Omen of Clarity (feral off-spec)
flex.why: Icy Veins: the first 20 Balance points are discretionary — only Nature's Grace matters.
Twentieth Restoration point to unlock Gift of Nature.

notes: Regrowth spam on the tank and raid; Healing Touch when Nature's Grace is up and the tank is low.
Icy Veins also lists a Moonglow variant (24/0/27) for mana-starved raids: same Balance path plus Moonglow 3/3, dropping Improved Regrowth.

builds.name: Feral — Cat DPS / Powershift (14/32/5)
builds.summary: The classic 14/32/5 feral: Heart of the Wild, Leader of the Pack, Blood Frenzy, Improved Shred, Predatory Strikes and Savage Fury in Feral; Natural Weapons, Omen of Clarity and Natural Shapeshifter in Balance; Furor in Restoration for powershifting (shift out and back in for 40 energy with Wolfshead Helm).

core.why: 40 energy on entering Cat Form — powershifting lives on this.
+20% Strength in Cat Form (+25% Stamina in Bear).
+3% crit for the whole melee group.
Clearcasting procs on melee hits — free Shreds.
-30% shapeshift mana cost — more powershifts per mana bar.

flex.why: Tier-2 Feral filler; Thick Hide also helps when you have to bear up.
Tier-1 Balance filler on the way to Natural Weapons.
Movement speed and dodge in Cat Form.

notes: Shred from behind (or Claw if not possible), Rip/Ferocious Bite at 5 points, powershift whenever energy is low and Clearcasting is not up.
Requires Wolfshead Helm (Leatherworking) and Manual Crowd Pummeler charges to reach rogue-level DPS.

builds.name: Feral — Bear Tank (14/32/5)
builds.summary: The tank version of 14/32/5: Feral Instinct (threat), Thick Hide (armor), Feral Charge, Faerie Fire (Feral), Heart of the Wild (+25% Stamina), Leader of the Pack, Savage Fury and Primal Fury, with Natural Weapons/Omen of Clarity/Natural Shapeshifter and Furor. Excellent off-tank and dungeon tank; main-tanks with the right gear.

core.why: 10 rage on shifting into Bear Form — instant Maul/Growl on the pull.

alternatives: Primal Fury 2 by dropping Feral Charge
flex.why: Rage on crit; one rank is the compromise to fit Feral Charge and Faerie Fire.
Attack power in forms; prerequisite for Heart of the Wild.

notes: Maul is the rotation (queue it on every swing), Swipe on packs, Demoralizing Roar and Faerie Fire on the pull; Feral Charge to open.
Icy Veins: prioritize tank talents over cat talents in a hybrid build — losing threat wipes raids, losing a little DPS does not.

builds.name: Balance — Moonkin (raid DPS, 35/0/16)
builds.summary: One Moonkin per raid for the +3% spell crit aura: Moonkin Form, Moonfury, Nature's Grace, Vengeance, Improved Starfire/Wrath/Moonfire and Moonglow for mana, with Improved Mark of the Wild, Reflection and Insect Swarm from Restoration. Mana-limited in Classic; damage is below mages and warlocks.

core.why: +3% spell crit to the group, +360% armor.
-9% mana on Moonfire/Starfire/Wrath — mana is the limiting factor.
DoT and -2% hit debuff on the boss.

flex.why: Tier-3 Balance filler to unlock Vengeance/Improved Starfire.
Restoration filler to reach Reflection and Insect Swarm.

notes: Starfire spam with Moonfire/Insect Swarm if debuff slots allow; Innervate yourself or the priest.
Bring one for the crit aura; a second Moonkin is rarely worth a raid slot in Classic Era.

builds.name: Restoration / Balance — PvP Healer (14/0/37)
builds.summary: The flag-carrier / battleground healer: Nature's Swiftness, Swiftmend, Gift of Nature, Improved Regrowth and Furor from Restoration; Nature's Grasp, Improved Entangling Roots, Natural Shapeshifter and Nature's Reach from Balance. Shift, root, run.

core.why: Instant Bash/Maul or a full energy bar when you shift.

flex.why: Filler to reach 10 Balance points for Nature's Reach.

notes: Feral 14/32/5 with Feral Charge is the other common Classic PvP druid; this build is the healer/flag-carrier.

builds.name: Leveling — Feral (Cat)
builds.summary: Cat Form from 20: Ferocity and Thick Hide early, Sharpened Claws, Predatory Strikes, Blood Frenzy/Primal Fury, Heart of the Wild at 40, Leader of the Pack at 41, then Furor and the Balance utility. Ends in the exact 14/32/5 cat build.

core.why: Cheaper Claw from the moment you get Cat Form.

alternatives: Furor at 10-14 (Bear Form rage) and Ferocity later
flex.why: Many take Furor first for instant bear rage at 10; this order maximizes cat damage.

notes: Claw/Rake -> Rip; Bear Form for elites and multi-pulls; Moonfire pulls until 20.
